description: An airline labels a technical snag Force Majeure, but the record does not establish that it was beyond the airline's control and unavoidable despite reasonable measures.

claim.statement: The airline cancelled my flight because of a technical snag and denied cancellation compensation under its Force Majeure clause. The notice does not explain whether the fault was beyond the airline's control or unavoidable despite reasonable measures. I checked in and request the statutory cancellation remedy.

expected.must_include_entitlement: evidence whether the technical fault was beyond the airline's control and could not have been avoided despite reasonable measures
